pairs.subject: trust-base
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/org/invites/accept/route.ts:49 The route takes the `any` that request.json() returns and casts it straight to a shape, with no decode through `unknown` and no checker. That makes it a trust-base member nothing spells: a census of directives and explicit `any` counts zero here, and a non-string token (for example {"token":1}) reaches `body.token?.trim()` on line 50 and throws a TypeError instead of returning the 400.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/org/invites/accept/route.ts:49 A standard decoder's `any` result is asserted to a shape with no check. The same shape appears at src/app/api/org/members/route.ts:58, src/app/api/org/invites/route.ts:95 and src/app/invite/[token]/AcceptInviteForm.tsx:53 (res.json() cast to AcceptResult). The technique's cure (decode to `unknown`, then one checking function) is not used in this context.
